The vis-network.min.js file next to this one (vis-network 9.1.9, dist build) includes code from the packages
below. Their licence texts follow, as published in each package.

It also includes vis-data 7.1.7 (https://github.com/visjs/vis-data), whose licence texts are the same as
vis-network's own: LICENSE-APACHE-2.0.txt and LICENSE-MIT.txt.
